asset_ownership_interpretation: C.R.E.A.M. Finance describes its lending protocol as non-custodial. User positions are represented through smart-contract lending markets rather than a centralized custodial yield account, although users remain exposed to protocol, collateral, oracle and smart-contract risk.
notes: The non-custodial protocol model does not eliminate loss risk. The October 2021 exploit demonstrated that smart-contract and market-design failures can still impair user positions materially.
